```tsx
const longPressTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
```

```tsx
                  <Text>{p.name}</Text> ({p.type}): {p.description}
                </Text>
              ))}
            </>
          ) : (
            <Text>{popupSymbol}</Text>
          );
        })()}
      </ScrollView>
      <Pressable onPress={() => setPopupSymbol(null)}>
        <Text>Close</Text>
      </Pressable>
    </Animated.View>
  </Pressable>
</Modal>
```
